fields.Name: User Impersonation
fields.Description: Grants permission to temporarily view the application in server-enforced Read-Only ('View As User') mode as an eligible non-privileged user when MJ_ENABLE_USER_IMPERSONATION is also enabled on the server. Granted to zero roles by default.

fields.Name: User Impersonation: Act As (Allow Writes)
fields.Description: Grants optional write-enabled ('Act As') impersonation for non-production QA/Dev troubleshooting ONLY when MJ_ENABLE_USER_IMPERSONATION=true AND MJ_USER_IMPERSONATION_ALLOW_WRITES=true AND the caller holds an explicit direct Allow grant on this authorization (never inherited from parent 'User Impersonation'). Granted to zero roles by default.
